message:
♦️ **FLEX GUI PRO V9.1.6 IS LIVE! (AFTER EFFECTS)**

A dedicated smoothness release focused on performance profiling, eliminating UI lag, and optimizing panel overhead.

*(Install over your current version with your ZXP installer and restart After Effects once to apply the update.)*

♦️ **Lighter & Faster Engine Performance**
* **Optimized Interface Polling:** UI checks that previously executed on every state change are throttled to a few times a second at most, preventing stutter and high CPU usage.
* **Instant Tab Switching:** Tabs now render instantly and populate asynchronously.
* **Background Resource Pausing:** Idle animations and effects automatically pause shortly after your mouse leaves the panel and resume immediately upon return.
* **Adaptive Dynamic Blur:** Background blur automatically disables on slower machines if performance dips during scrolling.

♦️ **Re-Engineered Lightweight Themes**
* **Reduced GPU Load:** Theme particle counts have been cut by half and heavy glow shaders replaced with lightweight renders to keep the UI fluid.
* **Theme Performance Warnings:** Selecting any high-fx theme now displays a performance caveat so you can choose between visual style and raw speed.
* **Clean Default Accent:** New installations default to standard Accent Color for peak smoothness (legacy auto-selected themes migrate to Accent Color once).

♦️ **Navigation & UI Fixes**
* **Tab Strip Scrolling:** Hover and scroll your mouse wheel over the tab bar to quickly step through tabs.
* **FX Control Optimization:** Effects Control no longer triggers background layout passes when inactive.
